lead.label: 7m
lead.why: Abstract: 'Pharmacological studies have revealed the leader compound 2-(2,4-dioxo-1,4-dihydroquinazolin-3(2H)-yl)-N-[(2,4-dichlorophenyl)methyl]acetamide, which improved all the experimental convulsive syndrome rates in mice ...' (7m, R = CH2-2,4-diClC6H5).

reactions.conditions: Glycine (0.1 mol) in water/Et3N (1 equiv) added to the isothiocyanate (0.1 mol) in 2-propanol; boiled 30 min; acidified with HCl to pH 2; precipitate washed with water and boiled in acetone.
reactions.source: Results (Scheme 1) and 'General method of synthesis' in Materials and Methods (pp. 9, 17-18 of the accepted manuscript)

reactions.conditions: NaOH (3 equiv) in water at 50 C; 50% H2O2 (10 equiv, diluted 1:1) added dropwise at 5 C, temperature kept below 70 C; stirred 30 min; cooled, acidified with AcOH; precipitate recrystallised from DMF/ethanol.
reactions.source: Results (Scheme 1) and General method, p. 17-18. H2O2 listed because it is the oxidant that replaces S by O (the O may equally come from hydroxide); heavy atoms of the product other than that O come from 3.

reactions.conditions: Acid 4 (0.1 mol) in anhydrous dioxane with N,N'-carbonyldiimidazole (0.12 mol), boiled 2-4 h (acylimidazole); then amine (0.12 mol) added, boiled 2 h more; poured into water, precipitate washed with 2-propanol, recrystallised from DMF/2-propanol. CDI leaves no atom (CO2 and imidazole lost).
reactions.source: Scheme 2 and General method, p. 18; 7m entry in the compound list

notes: The amine for 7m is described only as 'the corresponding amine' of Scheme 2 (R = CH2-2,4-diClC6H5), so its name is derived: 2,4-dichlorobenzylamine; all reagents are said to be Sigma-Aldrich products. The paper's procedure text garbles names of 3 and 4 ('tetrahydroxy-quinazolin'); I used the main-text names. The experimental is one general method for 7a-7n, with 7m-specific amounts not given; intermediates 3 and 4 have no separate characterisation data. Step 3 treated as one pot (acylimidazole not isolated).
